plan.name: Check fridge and countertops first for a clean egg
plan.strategy: Focus on the fridge and countertops first, as these are common places to store eggs and may already have a clean one.
steps: Check the fridge to see if a clean egg is already inside.
If no clean egg is found in the fridge, check countertops 1 to 3 for an egg.
If an egg is found but not clean, use the sink to clean it before placing it in the microwave.
If no egg is found in the fridge or countertops, proceed to search cabinets.
